tasks.label: Flutter: all tests
tasks.detail: Every Dart test in the repo: each workspace package, then the root suites.

tasks.label: Build: Android APK (ad-hoc / direct install)
tasks.command: fvm flutter build apk --release --flavor balsm -t lib/brands/balsm/main_balsm.dart --dart-define-from-file=env/balsm/${input:env}.json --dart-define-from-file=env/${input:servers}.json

tasks.label: Build: Android App Bundle (Play store)
tasks.command: fvm flutter build appbundle --release --flavor balsm -t lib/brands/balsm/main_balsm.dart --dart-define-from-file=env/balsm/${input:env}.json --dart-define-from-file=env/${input:servers}.json

tasks.label: Build: iOS IPA (ad-hoc)
tasks.command: fvm flutter build ipa --release --flavor balsm -t lib/brands/balsm/main_balsm.dart --export-options-plist=ios/signing/adhoc.plist --dart-define-from-file=env/balsm/${input:env}.json --dart-define-from-file=env/${input:servers}.json

tasks.label: Build: iOS IPA (App Store / TestFlight)
tasks.command: fvm flutter build ipa --release --flavor balsm -t lib/brands/balsm/main_balsm.dart --export-options-plist=ios/signing/appstore.plist --dart-define-from-file=env/balsm/${input:env}.json --dart-define-from-file=env/${input:servers}.json

tasks.label: Build: iOS archive only (export in Xcode Organizer)
tasks.command: fvm flutter build ipa --release --flavor balsm -t lib/brands/balsm/main_balsm.dart --no-codesign --dart-define-from-file=env/balsm/${input:env}.json --dart-define-from-file=env/${input:servers}.json
